blocks.text: After breakfast, a tour through the city to the station, where an eco-friendly train climbs through the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys, exotic animals and birds, to the top of Corcovado. At 710 metres above sea level stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the city and its surroundings: the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and more.

blocks.text: After breakfast, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. After the cable car ride down, the tour continues to the old centre of Rio, with its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings; your guide then takes you to a local restaurant to taste the local cuisine.
